reason: A browser-based dsh Web UI plugin providing Schulte grid and rotating roulette games for use while waiting for model responses, with local settings and history storage.

summaries.zh: 在 dsh Web UI 侧边栏提供舒尔特方格和动态轮盘小游戏，并在浏览器本地保存设置与历史记录。
summaries.en: Adds Schulte grid and rotating roulette mini-games to the dsh Web UI sidebar, with settings and history stored locally in the browser.

capabilities: Provides browser-based Schulte grid and roulette games
Registers a sidebar entry in the dsh Web UI
Stores game history and settings in browser localStorage
